title: A person's placement or drop of one item
description: What POST /api/v1/review/{key}/place, /api/v1/review/{key}/archive and /api/v1/review/{key}/drop answer, and `ingestion review place --json`, `review archive --json` and `review drop --json` print. A placement's body names either a choice or a destination, a watch's the playlist it adds the video to, and either may name a cause and a note. An archive's body may name what the person liked, the channel, the theme or this item alone, which the side decision keeps as its cause, and it writes the read mark. A drop's body may name a cause, and a drop for low quality writes the low-quality mark. A service's token writes either mark only where it holds ingestion.marks.write. A service's body also names the login of the person it decides for. Sent again with the same body, each answers the decisions the first made and appends none.

key.description: The item's key, which a URL in the path resolves to.

decisions.description: The side decision, decided by person:<login>, then the read decision where the destination takes a side.
